name: stack
description: Two or three mini-scenes stacked vertically on a paper board, each panel any other scene template of the style (year-card, stat, framed-portrait, newspaper, paper-collage, kinetic-serif), sliding in from alternate sides. Like the split screen in the reference reel where a year card, a stat and a framed portrait share one frame. Panels run for the whole duration of the stack and are one level deep: a panel cannot be a stack.
useWhen: the speaker names two or three parallel things (a comparison, a before and after, a list of events)
several short facts belong to one sentence
a year, a number and a person are mentioned together
